titleCn: 但尼丁医疗中心新病人注册

paragraphs.text: Good morning, sir. How can I help you?
Hello there. Well, I've just moved to this city, and so I'd like to register as a new patient here.
Sure. I'll just get the right form.
Now, first, could I have a name, please?
Yes. My first name is Henry, my middle name is Ian, and the family name is Prestney. P-R-E-S-T-N-E-Y.
Right. And date of birth?
It's the 17th of March, 1975.
Great. And your address, please.
25. Oh, oh, no, that, that was my old house. My address here is number 34 Market Road.
Right. Could I have your home number, sir?
Um, let me remember it. I haven't learned it yet. 294. Sorry. 2938476. Yes, that's it. I've just had the phone connected.

All righty. Well, that's the contact details finished. Now, I need some other bits of information, if you don't mind. First, um, I need to ask you which ethnic group you most identify with out of New Zealand Maori, Cook Island Maori, European, Tongan, or Samoan.
Uh, European.
Right. Thanks. That's just for statistical purposes. You know, we have to gather that info for the Ministry of Health.
And are you a New Zealand citizen?
Yes, I am.
All right. I'll put that down. That's good. So you qualify for subsidized healthcare.
And now, do you hold any special cards, such as a high user card or a low income card?
Uh, yes, actually, I am a high user. I've had a lot of trouble with my back over the last ten years.
Fine. I'll write that down for our records here so that you'll get that discount.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten.
And now, so that we can apply to have your medical records transferred here, can you tell me the name of your previous health center?
Yes. It was called Castle Hill.
Okay. I haven't heard of that practice before, so it can't be on Stewart Island or I'd know it. And you don't sound like a Southlander anyway. So is it the North Island you've come from?
Yes, you're quite right.
Okay. Well, I'll get you to sign this release form here, which gives us permission to request the transfer of your file. And then I can write to them and have your records sent to us.
Thank you. That'll be good.

Yes. It only takes a week or so to arrive usually. Now, let's think about a doctor for you. There are six doctors at this center, so you have a choice. Do you want to enroll with any particular one of them?
Um, well, no, not really. Being new here, I don't know any of them, so it doesn't really matter. I'd rather not have a female doctor, though, if that's possible.
That's fine. I'll put down male. That gives you three options, but some of those doctors only work part-time hours here. So would that be okay with you?
Oh, I see. Well, since I do have a chronic problem, which is why I hold the card we were talking about earlier, I would prefer seeing someone who'd not be hard to get hold of at any time.
So you want a full-time doctor. I'll write that here. That is no problem, sir. Any other preferences?
Yes. My back is actually an old injury from playing rugby, so I'd like to see a sports specialist if possible.
Well, let's see. I'll assign you to Dr. Chang because he specializes in
